messages.subject: unmarked 0.9-3 released
parts:
A new version of unmarked is on CRAN and will soon be ready to download on all platforms. Several people had asked for the option to model N using a zero-inflated Poisson distribution. This is now possible in pcount and pcountOpen by setting mixture="ZIP". Other new features and details are described here: https://sites.google.com/site/unmarkedinfo/home/release-notes

Cheers,
Richard


_____________________________________
Richard Chandler, post-doc
USGS Patuxent Wildlife Research Center
301-497-5696
